svg.text: PG-1 wiring 9/10: Page switch -> PCF8574 board
Pole A only: lugs 1 2 3 4 and common A. Pole B (5 6 7 8 and B) stays empty. Common A goes to GND; that pin already has the carrier's jumper
on it, so solder this one on the PCF board's UNDERSIDE, on GND's joint.
back of the switch: lug numbers 1-8, A and B are moulded on it; drawn turned (it fits any way round)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
page switch: lug 1 (pole A, position 1) -> PCF8574:
page switch: lug 2 (pole A, position 2) -> PCF8574:
page switch: lug 3 (pole A, position 3) -> PCF8574:
page switch: lug 4 (pole A, position 4) -> PCF8574:
page switch: common A (the inner lug by the moulded
'A') -> PCF8574: 'GND' on the INPUT pins (left end)
pole A common: solder it on the UNDERSIDE of the PCF
board, on the GND pin's solder joint
